note: Accepted exceptions to the js-supply-chain gate (scripts/npm_audit_gate.mjs). Policy, entry format and the rules behind every field: docs/NPM_AUDIT_SEVERITY_POLICY_DECISION.md sections 4, 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3. An empty list is written as "allow": [] and never as a missing file. Adding an entry requires an owner decision; every field is required, the id is a GHSA id, and expiresOn may be at most 90 days after approvedOn (D-3). An entry whose advisory has left the audit fails the gate and must be deleted (D-5). The braces exception was retired under D-5 and section 6.3 E-6; remediation and validation: docs/BRACES_REMEDIATION.md.
